text: # Ocean Web Surface — Design System Authority for all visual work in the Leptos web surface (`crates/ocean-surface-ui`, `styles/*.css`, `index.html`). Ocean's OWN identity — not an agency re-brand — applied at **product register**: the UI serves the task; brand energy is rationed, never decorative. Register rule: a user fluent in Linear/Figma/Raycast should trust every control on sight. Familiar affordances, one component vocabulary, restrained color. **Control density is a design defect.** The surface holds exactly the controls the current moment needs; everything else is conditional, collapsed behind one overflow, or revealed on intent (hover/focus). A row of same-weight buttons is failure — one primary affordance, quiet metadata, ghost triggers. ## 1. Identity The OCEAN depth ramp comes from the ASCII splash banner in the TUI (`ocean-os/crates/ocean-tui/src/splash.rs`), deep indigo rising to bright aqua (xterm 17→19→25→31→38→44→50→87). The active logo direction is now the circular neumorphic wave mark, not the ASCII banner and not a terminal prompt glyph. Reference asset: `public/brand/master-1024.png` (mirrored as `public/brand/ocean-mark.svg`). Logo implementation target: - Replace the current three-line `WaveLogo` and text-only header wordmark with an inline SVG circular mark component that preserves the reference geometry: circular badge, stacked wave cutouts, teal-to-blue depth ramp, matte dark relief, and shallow inner/outer shadow. - Keep the SVG inline in the Leptos bundle, not as ``, so the same asset can animate in web and Tauri. Name internal layers (`rim`, `wave-1`, `wave-2`, `wave-3`, `deep-water`, `wordmark`) so CSS can target state motion. - Test three lockups before choosing: mark-only, lowercase `ocean`, and tighter uppercase `OCEAN` with less spacing than the current landing wordmark. - Avoid prompt/code symbolism completely: no `>`, `_`, cursor, brackets, terminal glyphs, sparkle/star motifs, mascots, or Codex-adjacent shapes. - Tauri consumes the same Trunk-built Leptos bundle, so the web logo component is the primary fix for both browser and native shell. Generate Tauri app icons from the final mark only after the web lockup is accepted. Never gradient-clip text. The ramp is always painted as solid colors on discrete elements, or as vector fills inside the circular mark. The page is near-black; the working accent (`--ocean-6` cyan) appears ONLY at: - Primary actions (send, approve, join, submit, create) — solid cyan fill with dark ink (`--fg-on-accent`), never white text, never a gradient fill. - Live/active states: voice orb recording, speaking ring, live dots, active selection fills. - Focus rings (single cyan ring). Everything else is neutral: near-black surfaces, low-opacity white borders, the near-white/grey text ramp. No teal-mint (legacy #7fe7c8), no navy chrome, no magenta/purple (rejected 2026-07-04). ## 2. Tokens (`styles/tokens.css` — the only place colors are defined) Surfaces - `--bg: #060606` page - `--bg-raised: #0A0A0A` bars, panels, drawers - `--bg-elevated: #141414` cards, inputs, chips, wells - `--bg-hover: #1B1C21` hover fill on elevated surfaces - `--bg-well: #23252B` special data wells (code, diff, transcript wells) Text - `--fg: #FAFCFF` headings, primary content - `--fg-2: #B8B9BB` body secondary - `--fg-3: #909098` labels, metadata - `--fg-4: #5A5C63` disabled only — never for readable content Brand — the OCEAN ramp - `--ocean-1..8`: `#00005F #0000AF #005FAF #0087AF #00AFD7 #00D7D7 #00FFD7 #5FFFFF` (identity surfaces only: banner rows, wordmark letters, data-fill gradient) - `--accent: var(--ocean-6)` interactive accent (links, active text, hot states) - `--accent-bright: var(--ocean-7)` live highlights - `--accent-deep: var(--ocean-4)` depth end of data gradients - `--fg-on-accent: #03181A` ink on accent fills — accent fills NEVER take white text - `--gradient: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--ocean-6), var(--ocean-4))` DATA fills (chart bars) only — never buttons, never text - `--accent-soft: rgba(0,215,215,0.12)` tinted fills - `--accent-ring: rgba(0,215,215,0.45)` focus ring color Status (semantic; used for tool state, call state, deltas, diffs) - `--ok: #1ED760`, `--ok-soft: rgba(30, 215, 96, 0.12)` - `--err: #FF4D67`, `--err-soft: rgba(255, 77, 103, 0.12)` - `--warn: #FFB224`, `--warn-soft: rgba(255, 178, 36, 0.12)` - `--info: #6AA6FF`, `--info-soft: rgba(106, 166, 255, 0.12)` - `--running: var(--warn)` (in-flight tool state) Borders - `--border-subtle: rgba(255,255,255,0.06)` - `--border: rgba(255,255,255,0.10)` - `--border-strong: rgba(255,255,255,0.20)` Type - `--font: 'Poppins', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif` - `--mono: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace` - Scale (fixed px, product register): 11 label / 12 small / 13 secondary / 14 body / 15 emphasized / 18 title / 22 display. Body line-height 1.55. - Uppercase labels: 11px, weight 600, `letter-spacing: 0.08em`, `--fg-3`. - Mono is for DATA (paths, ids, tokens, numbers, code), never for UI labels. Radii — pill is GEOMETRY, never chrome - `--radius-sm: 4px` chips, badges, tabs, menu items, mono data chips - `--radius: 6px` inputs, buttons, selects, list rows, dropdown menus - `--radius-lg: 10px` cards, panels, modals, composer dock - `--radius-pill: 999px` true circles/capsules ONLY: status dots, the voice orb, progress bars, scrollbar thumbs. Never on a text-bearing control — pill buttons/inputs/chips read 2015-SaaS and are banned (2026-07-06). Shadows / glow - `--shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.40)` - `--shadow-md: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)` - `--shadow-lg: 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,0.65)` overlays/slide-overs only - `--glow-brand: 0 0 32px rgba(0,215,215,0.28)` voice orb / live moments only Material — molded from the digital ocean - `--specular: rgba(255,255,255,0.08)` top-edge light on raised surfaces - `--specular-soft: rgba(255,255,255,0.05)` fainter top-edge (elev-1 rows/controls) - `--specular-live: rgba(95,255,255,0.16)` aqua specular for live/active states - `--elev-1` inset specular-soft + tight drop — controls, menu rows, chips - `--elev-2` inset specular + mid drop — cards, docks, list panels - `--elev-3` inset specular + deep drop — popovers, modals, tooltips - `--well` inset shadow + faint bottom specular — inputs, data/code wells - `--well-deep` deeper inset — deepest wells (transcript, diff bodies) - `--pressed: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.60)` :active pressed-in - `--glow-thinking: 0 0 24px rgba(0,215,215,0.10)` breathing cognition glow - `--glow-live: 0 0 20px rgba(0,255,215,0.16)` active-streaming glow - `--pointer-x / --pointer-y: 50%` pointer-light origin (root listener writes) - `--pointer-light: rgba(95,255,255,0.04)` faint radial specular at pointer Motion - `--ease: cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1)`; `--dur-fast: 160ms`; `--dur: 240ms`; `--dur-slow: 420ms`; `--ease-tide: cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.28,1)` rise-from-depth (tidal entrance curve). - Motion conveys state only. No bounce, no elastic, no decorative entrance choreography — the ONLY entrance allowed is the tidal rise for overlays/popovers (see Material). - EVERY animation gets a `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` kill. Controls & layout - `--ctl-h: 34px` standard control height; `--ctl-h-sm: 28px` compact chips - `--focus-ring: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-ring)` - `--shell-max: 1120px` desktop shell width ## 3. Control recipes (the ONE vocabulary — every domain uses these verbatim) The reference component is the header overflow menu (`ocean-more__menu`): an elevated panel, hairline border, tight radius, plain text rows — no icons, no subtitles, no accent chrome. Every new component must justify any element that menu doesn't have (an icon lockup, a subtitle, a fill) before adding it. Primary button (send, approve, submit, join, create): - `background: var(--accent)`, `color: var(--fg-on-accent)` (dark ink — never white), weight 600, `--radius`, compact height (`--ctl-h-sm` in docks), padding 0 14px, border: none. - Hover: `filter: brightness(1.12)`. Press: `transform: scale(0.985)`. - Disabled: `opacity: 0.45`, no pointer events. Secondary button (cancel, leave, toggles, header actions): - `background: var(--bg-elevated)`, `1px solid var(--border)`, `--fg` text, `--radius`, height `--ctl-h`. - Hover: `background: var(--bg-hover); border-color: var(--border-strong)`. - NEVER pair a border with a wide soft shadow. Ghost button (icon buttons, close ×, drawer heads): - Transparent bg, `--fg-3` content; hover: `--bg-elevated` fill + `--fg`. Danger: secondary shape with `--err` text; fill `--err-soft` on hover. Deny/halt follows danger; approve follows primary. Inputs & textareas: - `background: var(--bg-raised)`, `1px solid var(--border)`, `--radius`, `--fg` text, placeholder `--fg-3` (not dimmer). - Focus: `border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: var(--focus-ring)`; no outline. Selects (project picker, thinking, model, form selects): - `appearance: none` + the recipe above + custom chevron as inline `background-image` SVG (stroke `#909098`), `background-position: right 10px center`, padding-right 30px. Same height as buttons. Sans font, NOT mono. Chips/badges: `--radius-sm`, `--bg-elevated` + `--border-subtle`, 12px text. State chips tint with the matching `*-soft` bg + solid status text. Focus: `:focus-visible { box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); outline: none; }` on all interactive elements. Never remove focus affordance without replacing it. Scrollbars: keep the existing thin overlay treatment, thumb `rgba(255,255,255,0.12)`, hover `rgba(255,255,255,0.22)`. No accent scrollbars. Failure surfaces: - Status chip (`.ocean-status`): one short line, state-label register (`turn failed: `), NEVER raw payloads/JSON/multi-line text; source normalizes before set — CSS ellipsis is only a guard. - Full error payloads go to the console log and (when a turn/tool errored) render as expanded Err tool blocks in the transcript — the transcript is the detail carrier, the chip is the signal. - Failed user turns must never dangle silently: the failure must be visible in status AND recoverable (input preserved, resend possible). - Errors follow voice rules: explain what went wrong in the interface voice, never vague, no apology. ## Material — molded from the digital ocean One overhead light source. RAISED surfaces catch a top-edge specular (`--specular`) and cast a dark drop below; CARVED wells fall away into darker water. Elevation replaces borders — an element takes the border recipe OR the elevation recipe, never both. Agent cognition is bioluminescence: existing state hooks (`is-*` classes, data attrs the Rust already emits) drive the glow tokens — no new state plumbing, only new declarations on hooks that already exist. RAISED — interactive controls, cards, popovers: - `box-shadow: var(--elev-N)`: `--elev-1` controls/rows/chips, `--elev-2` cards/docks/list panels, `--elev-3` popovers/modals/tooltips. - REMOVE any 1px border on the same element — the specular inset replaces the outline. (The §5 "1px border + ≥16px blur" ban stands.) CARVED — inputs, code/diff/data wells: - Darker bg (`--bg-well`, deeper for the deepest wells) + `box-shadow: var(--well)` (or `--well-deep`). PRESSED — `:active` on raised controls: - `box-shadow: var(--pressed); transform: translateY(1px)`. The focus ring (`--focus-ring`) is unchanged and stacks with elevation. Bioluminescence state map — attach to existing hooks only: - Thinking: `--glow-thinking`, a slow breathing keyframe (opacity/scale). - Tool running: lift `--elev-1` → `--elev-2` and brighten to `--specular-live`. - Streaming: materialize — incoming content fades/translates in on the tide. - Permission wait: `--warn` ring pulse over a `--warn-soft` fill. - Live call: `--accent` dot pulse. The live-state color map holds everywhere — live = `--accent` pulse, connected = `--ok`, reconnecting = `--warn`, failed/barge = `--err`. Agent-response loading: - Replace the current pending-response sonar ping and any text like `ocean ▸` with the circular Ocean mark in motion. - The ideal motion is fluid current inside the logo: wave bands subtly shear, drift, and churn under the circular clip while the rim stays calm. It should read like ocean current moving inside the mark, not a spinning loader, not a bouncing dot, and not decorative page-load choreography. - Drive it from the existing send-to-first-token pending hook and streaming state in `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/transcript.rs`; do not add daemon state for this. The spinner is surface presentation only. - Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, render the static circular mark with a small live-state glow and no current animation. Tidal entrance — overlays/popovers/slide-overs only, never page load: - One keyframe block per file that needs it: `from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px) }` to settled, `var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-tide)`. - Conveys "rose from depth", not decoration. Killed under reduced-motion. Pointer light: - A root listener writes `--pointer-x` / `--pointer-y`; opted-in surfaces paint a faint radial specular (`--pointer-light`) at the pointer. - Gates: opt-in only (never global), off under `prefers-reduced-motion` and on coarse/touch pointers. Faint enough to read as light, not chrome. Portability — same grammar, three renderers. These tokens map to GPUI shadow + highlight layers and to iOS materials (RAISED → elevated material, CARVED → inset well). The names and recipes travel; only the renderer changes. ## 4. Layout - Shell: `max-width: var(--shell-max)` desktop, full-bleed below 960px. - Header: 56px raised bar (`--bg-raised`, bottom `--border-subtle`), OCEAN ramp wordmark left, controls right, 8px gaps, all controls `--ctl-h-sm`. Visible header controls are capped: context (project/session), ONE nav icon (sessions), text metadata (tokens/status), and ONE `⋯` overflow holding everything else (council, rooms, mute, capture). - Transcript prose measure: `max-width: 72ch` for text blocks. - Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32/48. Vary rhythm; don't pad everything 12px. - Cards are earned: components that ARE cards (kanban card, stat, session item) get `--bg-elevated` + `--border-subtle` + `--radius-lg`. NEVER nest cards. ## 5. Bans (refuse-and-rewrite) - No teal/cyan (#7fe7c8 family), no navy (#06111d family), no legacy yellow `--user`. All literals route through tokens; the ONLY raw values allowed in domain files are white/black alphas for one-off masks — and prefer tokens. - No gradient text (`background-clip: text`). - No `border-left`/`border-right` accent stripes > 1px. (Existing drawer left-rails: replace with tinted fills or dot indicators.) - No 1px border + ≥16px blur shadow on the same element — elevation replaces the border; an element takes the border recipe OR the elevation recipe, never both. - No border-radius > 16px on cards/inputs (pills exempt). - No glassmorphism as default; `backdrop-filter` only on overlay backdrops. - No decorative motion; no page-load choreography. - Uniform icon+heading+text card grids and hero-metric lockups: no. A launcher or affordance is a labeled control, never an icon+title+subtitle lockup. - No pill-shaped text controls: `--radius-pill` is reserved for dots, the orb, progress bars, and scrollbar thumbs. - No full-width accent slab buttons; a primary action is content-width at control height, placed where the flow reads. ## 6. Per-surface notes - Landing (`transcript__landing`): the OCEAN banner hero — 8 `pre` rows, one ramp color per row, fluid mono sizing. Title is visually-hidden (screen readers only). Below the banner sits ONE quiet secondary control (`transcript__sessions-launcher`, "Sessions") that opens the sessions modal — no icon, no subtitle, no card, no glow bath. - Tool drawers: quiet single-line disclosures, mono label, status dot (ok/err/running) instead of colored rails. - Thinking: italic 13px `--fg-3` with pill toggle; never louder than answers. - Agent components (kanban/table/chart/…): data-forward, tight 12/13px type, mono numerals, consistent headers (11px uppercase label style), hairline `--border-subtle` separators; interactive rows hover `--bg-hover`. - Diff/code: `--bg-well` body, mono 12px, add/del tints via `*-soft` + solid gutter text; filename heads 11px uppercase labels. - Voice orb: neutral elevated circle idle; recording = solid accent fill + `--glow-brand` + pulse; transcribing = warn tint pulse. Kill pulses under reduced-motion. - Composer: ONE compact dock card; the form is the only frame and owns the `:focus-within` ring. The chromeless textarea occupies the full first row. The second row is one toolbar: voice orb + its settings trigger at left, borderless turn-control minis in the flexible middle, and Send/Stop in one fixed action slot at right. Idle desktop geometry is 8px dock padding, a 32px minimum writing row, 4px row gap, and 34px toolbar controls (86px total before external margins). Multiline input grows the first row upward to the existing 240px cap. No inset textarea well, nested input card, detached action button, permanent caption, or control spanning both rows. - Slide-overs (sessions/rooms): `--bg-raised` panel, `--shadow-lg`, backdrop `rgba(6,6,6,0.72)` + blur(4px); 280ms slide with reduced-motion fallback. - Sessions/rooms/call rows follow the plain-row register (§3): title left, mono metadata right-aligned in `--fg-3`, destructive actions revealed on hover/focus only, ONE join/leave affordance per row. No icon+title+subtitle lockups, no same-weight button rows — density is conditional rendering and a single overflow, not stacked affordances. - Live states (call/livekit): live dot = `--err`-family red pulse? No — live recording convention is red, but our live accent is the brand: use `--accent` pulsing dot for "live", `--ok` for connected, `--warn` for reconnecting, `--err` for failed/barge. - Extension side panel (`compact.css`): same system, tighter paddings; never fork colors. ## 7. Behavioral constraints (do not break) - Every existing class name stays. This is a re-skin + markup-quality pass, not a rename. `sessions-overlay`/`rooms-overlay` close-on-click checks, `lk-tile-*` ids, `ocean-map__*`, `oceanRenderMap`/`oceanRenderSocialVideo` contracts, `#ocean-float-corridor` inline-style mutation, `is-*` modifiers — all load-bearing. Keep `is-*` selectors scoped to their family. - Canvas card geometry (left/top/width/height inline styles from Rust) must keep `position: absolute` + `box-sizing: border-box` semantics. - Height chains: `html, body { height: 100% }` + `.ocean-surface { height: 100%; height: 100dvh }` stay (extension side-panel dvh collapse, OCEAN-70). - Google Places theming flows through the documented custom properties; update values to this palette, keep the property names.

content.text: # Ocean Web Surface — Design System Authority for all visual work in the Leptos web surface (`crates/ocean-surface-ui`, `styles/*.css`, `index.html`). Ocean's OWN identity — not an agency re-brand — applied at **product register**: the UI serves the task; brand energy is rationed, never decorative. Register rule: a user fluent in Linear/Figma/Raycast should trust every control on sight. Familiar affordances, one component vocabulary, restrained color. **Control density is a design defect.** The surface holds exactly the controls the current moment needs; everything else is conditional, collapsed behind one overflow, or revealed on intent (hover/focus). A row of same-weight buttons is failure — one primary affordance, quiet metadata, ghost triggers. ## 1. Identity The OCEAN depth ramp comes from the ASCII splash banner in the TUI (`ocean-os/crates/ocean-tui/src/splash.rs`), deep indigo rising to bright aqua (xterm 17→19→25→31→38→44→50→87). The active logo direction is now the circular neumorphic wave mark, not the ASCII banner and not a terminal prompt glyph. Reference asset: `public/brand/master-1024.png` (mirrored as `public/brand/ocean-mark.svg`). Logo implementation target: - Replace the current three-line `WaveLogo` and text-only header wordmark with an inline SVG circular mark component that preserves the reference geometry: circular badge, stacked wave cutouts, teal-to-blue depth ramp, matte dark relief, and shallow inner/outer shadow. - Keep the SVG inline in the Leptos bundle, not as ``, so the same asset can animate in web and Tauri. Name internal layers (`rim`, `wave-1`, `wave-2`, `wave-3`, `deep-water`, `wordmark`) so CSS can target state motion. - Test three lockups before choosing: mark-only, lowercase `ocean`, and tighter uppercase `OCEAN` with less spacing than the current landing wordmark. - Avoid prompt/code symbolism completely: no `>`, `_`, cursor, brackets, terminal glyphs, sparkle/star motifs, mascots, or Codex-adjacent shapes. - Tauri consumes the same Trunk-built Leptos bundle, so the web logo component is the primary fix for both browser and native shell. Generate Tauri app icons from the final mark only after the web lockup is accepted. Never gradient-clip text. The ramp is always painted as solid colors on discrete elements, or as vector fills inside the circular mark. The page is near-black; the working accent (`--ocean-6` cyan) appears ONLY at: - Primary actions (send, approve, join, submit, create) — solid cyan fill with dark ink (`--fg-on-accent`), never white text, never a gradient fill. - Live/active states: voice orb recording, speaking ring, live dots, active selection fills. - Focus rings (single cyan ring). Everything else is neutral: near-black surfaces, low-opacity white borders, the near-white/grey text ramp. No teal-mint (legacy #7fe7c8), no navy chrome, no magenta/purple (rejected 2026-07-04). ## 2. Tokens (`styles/tokens.css` — the only place colors are defined) Surfaces - `--bg: #060606` page - `--bg-raised: #0A0A0A` bars, panels, drawers - `--bg-elevated: #141414` cards, inputs, chips, wells - `--bg-hover: #1B1C21` hover fill on elevated surfaces - `--bg-well: #23252B` special data wells (code, diff, transcript wells) Text - `--fg: #FAFCFF` headings, primary content - `--fg-2: #B8B9BB` body secondary - `--fg-3: #909098` labels, metadata - `--fg-4: #5A5C63` disabled only — never for readable content Brand — the OCEAN ramp - `--ocean-1..8`: `#00005F #0000AF #005FAF #0087AF #00AFD7 #00D7D7 #00FFD7 #5FFFFF` (identity surfaces only: banner rows, wordmark letters, data-fill gradient) - `--accent: var(--ocean-6)` interactive accent (links, active text, hot states) - `--accent-bright: var(--ocean-7)` live highlights - `--accent-deep: var(--ocean-4)` depth end of data gradients - `--fg-on-accent: #03181A` ink on accent fills — accent fills NEVER take white text - `--gradient: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--ocean-6), var(--ocean-4))` DATA fills (chart bars) only — never buttons, never text - `--accent-soft: rgba(0,215,215,0.12)` tinted fills - `--accent-ring: rgba(0,215,215,0.45)` focus ring color Status (semantic; used for tool state, call state, deltas, diffs) - `--ok: #1ED760`, `--ok-soft: rgba(30, 215, 96, 0.12)` - `--err: #FF4D67`, `--err-soft: rgba(255, 77, 103, 0.12)` - `--warn: #FFB224`, `--warn-soft: rgba(255, 178, 36, 0.12)` - `--info: #6AA6FF`, `--info-soft: rgba(106, 166, 255, 0.12)` - `--running: var(--warn)` (in-flight tool state) Borders - `--border-subtle: rgba(255,255,255,0.06)` - `--border: rgba(255,255,255,0.10)` - `--border-strong: rgba(255,255,255,0.20)` Type - `--font: 'Poppins', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif` - `--mono: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace` - Scale (fixed px, product register): 11 label / 12 small / 13 secondary / 14 body / 15 emphasized / 18 title / 22 display. Body line-height 1.55. - Uppercase labels: 11px, weight 600, `letter-spacing: 0.08em`, `--fg-3`. - Mono is for DATA (paths, ids, tokens, numbers, code), never for UI labels. Radii — pill is GEOMETRY, never chrome - `--radius-sm: 4px` chips, badges, tabs, menu items, mono data chips - `--radius: 6px` inputs, buttons, selects, list rows, dropdown menus - `--radius-lg: 10px` cards, panels, modals, composer dock - `--radius-pill: 999px` true circles/capsules ONLY: status dots, the voice orb, progress bars, scrollbar thumbs. Shadows / glow - `--shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.40)` - `--shadow-md: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)` - `--shadow-lg: 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,0.65)` overlays/slide-overs only - `--glow-brand: 0 0 32px rgba(0,215,215,0.28)` voice orb / live moments only Material — molded from the digital ocean - `--specular: rgba(255,255,255,0.08)` top-edge light on raised surfaces - `--specular-soft: rgba(255,255,255,0.05)` fainter top-edge (elev-1 rows/controls) - `--specular-live: rgba(95,255,255,0.16)` aqua specular for live/active states - `--elev-1` inset specular-soft + tight drop — controls, menu rows, chips - `--elev-2` inset specular + mid drop — cards, docks, list panels - `--elev-3` inset specular + deep drop — popovers, modals, tooltips - `--well` inset shadow + faint bottom specular — inputs, data/code wells - `--well-deep` deeper inset — deepest wells (transcript, diff bodies) - `--pressed: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.60)` :active pressed-in - `--glow-thinking: 0 0 24px rgba(0,215,215,0.10)` breathing cognition glow - `--glow-live: 0 0 20px rgba(0,255,215,0.16)` active-streaming glow - `--pointer-x / --pointer-y: 50%` pointer-light origin (root listener writes) - `--pointer-light: rgba(95,255,255,0.04)` faint radial specular at pointer Motion - `--ease: cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1)`; `--dur-fast: 160ms`; `--dur: 240ms`; `--dur-slow: 420ms`; `--ease-tide: cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.28,1)` rise-from-depth (tidal entrance curve). - Motion conveys state only. # Dynamic Island + `⌘P` — Implementation Specification > Implementation companion to `OCEAN_DESKTOP_NORTH_STAR.md`. > > Scope: define the smallest complete first build of Ocean Desktop's Dynamic > Island and its keyboard-first session focus/search mode. This is deliberately > concrete: data contracts, components, files, state transitions, keyboard > routing, CSS geometry, acceptance checks, and explicitly deferred work. > > The practical delivery sequence and commit gates live in > [`OCEAN_DYNAMIC_ISLAND_BUILD_PLAN.md`](OCEAN_DYNAMIC_ISLAND_BUILD_PLAN.md). ## Decision summary Build this before a permanent left rail. The first release is **not** a generalized desktop task system. It is a Tauri-only, titlebar-adjacent focus surface backed by the existing daemon session catalogue. ### V1 ships - compact Dynamic Island in the desktop header - focused session identity plus a count of active-background sessions - click to open an Island overlay - overlay lists active/recent sessions with project/path/branch/origin metadata - selecting a result calls the existing `Daemon::switch_session(id, title)` and moves that session into the center transcript - `⌘P` opens that same overlay in search mode - fuzzy search over existing session metadata - arrow keys, Enter, Escape, click-outside behavior ### V1 does not ship - inline reply to a background session - cross-session live streaming in the Island - server-side/session-content semantic search - approvals, CI, GitHub, browser, rooms, Council, files, or PR results - a left rail - a replacement for the existing web/extension Sessions modal Those are follow-on waves after the core focus interaction is proven. ## Phase 2A — approved read-only attention slice V1 proved the focus loop. The next slice turns the expanded Island into a truthful cross-session activity surface without giving it mutation authority. This section is binding for Phase 2A. ### Authoritative sources Use the daemon's existing global snapshots: - `GET /v1/requests` for queued, running, waiting-for-permission, cancelling, and errored request state across sessions. - `GET /v1/permissions` for currently pending permissions and their request/session/tool/reason metadata. - `GET /v1/agent/sessions` remains the title/project/path lookup catalogue. Poll the two attention snapshots every three seconds while the Tauri Island is mounted, refresh immediately on mount and overlay open, and retain the last good snapshot if one request fails. This is an interim read-only projection, not a new runtime store. A unified replayable daemon attention stream remains the later target. Never infer running, blocked, failed, or complete state from session timestamps. Timestamps may order authoritative items; they may not create them. ### Projection rules Project the snapshot into these display states: - `NeedsHuman`: every pending permission; de-duplicate its matching `waiting_for_permission` request. - `Running`: queued or running requests. - `Cancelling`: cancelling requests. - `Failed`: the three newest errored requests in the current daemon registry. - Omit completed and cancelled requests. Join `session_id` to the fetched session catalogue for title/project display. Use a short session id fallback when the catalogue has not caught up. Do not render raw permission `args` in the Island; the existing transcript-adjacent permission surface remains the detail/action authority. ### Compact-state priority The closed chip preserves the focused session title. Its trailing status reads, in priority order: 1. ` need attention` 2. ` running` 3. existing ` recent` The dot uses `--warn` for human attention, the existing live accent for running, and the normal/empty treatment otherwise. No pulse or decorative animation. The accessible label and one polite live region announce the same factual count. ### Expanded interaction The popover remains one dialog and one material surface. When activity exists, render an `Activity` section between search and session results: - needs-human items first, then failed, cancelling, and running; - one plain summary row per item, with state, session title, and concise detail; - clicking or pressing Enter on a summary toggles its inline disclosure; - the disclosure may show project, tool/request state, and bounded reason; - one ghost `Open session` action focuses the associated session through `Daemon::switch_session(id, title)` and closes the Island. Attention controls participate in a real Tab focus trap. Arrow-key/ `aria-activedescendant` session navigation remains scoped to the search input, so using a disclosure button can never accidentally switch the selected session. Render the scrim/popover with `position: fixed` and a high z-index so it is not clipped by the header and so its click-outside behavior is reliable. ### Compact chip behavior When no focused session exists: ```text Ocean · no session [open] ``` When focused session exists: ```text {title} · {project?} · {recent_count} recent ``` Constraints: - max compact width `520px` on wide desktop headers; responsive percentage and narrow-window caps must preserve both titlebar control zones - title line truncates - project is optional and truncates before title is hidden - no persistent animation unless attention becomes real in later slices - click toggles Browse; if Search is open, click closes - chip itself must not carry `data-tauri-drag-region` because it is interactive ### Overlay behavior - browse result limit: 8 initial rows (scroll beyond) - search result limit: 20 initial rows - result rows show: - title - project/path, branch, origin, relative time, turns - focused marker when applicable - click result: switch and close - no inline reply in V1 - background/scrim click: close ### Search-mode focus effect In `Island`, add an effect equivalent to `PaletteView`: ```rust Effect::new(move |_| { if mode.get() == IslandMode::Search { request_animation_frame(move || { if let Some(input) = input_ref.get() { let _ = input.focus(); input.select(); } }); } }); ``` Use the repo's existing rAF/focus utility if available; do not invent a setTimeout-based race. ## `app.rs` changes ### Imports and modules 1. Add `mod island;` in the crate root (`lib.rs` / module declaration location used by the project). 2. Import `Island`, `IslandMode` in `app.rs`. ### State Near `workspace_open` setup: ```rust let island_mode: RwSignal = RwSignal::new(IslandMode::Closed); let daemon_for_island = StoredValue::new(daemon.clone()); ``` No localStorage persistence in V1. An open overlay should not survive restart. ### Header mount Replace the Tauri interpretation of the current Sessions header trigger. Current code at `app.rs` roughly lines 958–971 renders a permanent labeled `Sessions` button. Change the header layout to: ```rust
...
... existing runtime + overflow + workspace controls ...
``` Do **not** move runtime status into the Island in V1. It already has stable presentation and should remain where it is. ### Shortcut routing Add a new focused listener before/alongside the current Escape listener: ```rust let _island_shortcut = window_event_listener(ev::keydown, move |e| { let is_cmd_p = (e.meta_key() || e.ctrl_key()) && !e.shift_key() && !e.alt_key() && e.key().eq_ignore_ascii_case("p"); if is_cmd_p && in_tauri { e.prevent_default(); e.stop_propagation(); island_mode.set(IslandMode::Search); } }); on_cleanup(move || _island_shortcut.remove()); ``` Use both Meta and Ctrl so the browser/PWA can share the behavior later if wanted, but gate initial mounting/handling on `in_tauri` to prevent intercepting browser print on non-Tauri hosts. ### Escape priority Update the existing global Escape ladder: ```text 1. PaletteView / Island local input handlers stop propagation themselves. 2. Council stage 3. Island overlay 4. Rooms 5. Sessions modal 6. Deck ``` The Island component's own input handler must call `stop_propagation()` on Escape after closing itself. The global handler only catches unhandled Escape from click/browse state. ### Sessions command Keep `toggle-sessions` unchanged in V1. It remains the deep browse fallback. Add a new command registry entry: ```rust Command { id: "focus-search", title: "Search Ocean…".into(), hint: Some("⌘P".into()), scope: CommandScope::App, slash: None, enabled: Signal::derive(move || in_tauri), run: Callback::new(move |_| island_mode.set(IslandMode::Search)), } ``` This makes the action discoverable in `⌘K` and native menubar work later while preserving the semantic separation: `⌘K` invokes the search surface; `⌘P` is the direct shortcut. ### No transcript/composer changes in V1 Do not remove the Sessions landing action or alter the composer in the Island first slice. The Island must prove useful before changing existing navigation fallbacks. ## Keyboard specification | Key | When Island input is focused | Behavior | | --- | --- | --- | | `⌘P` / `Ctrl+P` | anywhere in Tauri app | open/replace with Search mode; focus/select input | | `Esc` | search/browse overlay | close Island; prevent bubble | | `ArrowDown` | results non-empty | next result, wrapping | | `ArrowUp` | results non-empty | previous result, wrapping | | `Enter` | result selected | `switch_session`; close Island | | `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` | search/browse overlay | keep focus in the combobox; results use `aria-activedescendant` | | click chip | closed | open Browse | | click chip | open | close | | click scrim | open | close | | click row | open | `switch_session`; close | Do not bind `⌘P` within a textarea only. It must work while transcript, composer, workspace, or header controls have focus. Respect IME composition if the app already exposes an equivalent guard; otherwise add it before intercepting the shortcut. ## CSS implementation Create `styles/island.css`; add it to `index.html` after `chrome.css` and before `panels.css`. Also add it to any explicit extension-style copy/build list only if the build requires every stylesheet to exist there. The component does not mount off-Tauri, so it remains visually inert on web/extension. ### Geometry tokens ```css :root { --island-max-w: 360px; --island-popover-w: min(560px, calc(100vw - 32px)); --island-top: 64px; /* header bottom + seam; revise against live Tauri shot */ } ``` ### Required layering ```text workspace pane 50 web deck 60 modal sessions 100 Island scrim/popover 120 command palette 1100 ``` The Island must sit above the workspace and ordinary panels, below `⌘K` palette. This means opening `⌘K` visually wins even if Island search is open; opening the palette should close Island as a small follow-up hardening task. ### Styling constraints - Island chip uses the existing OCEAN depth ramp, not iOS visual imitation. - No giant pill and no floating dashboard card. - Use a compact rounded capsule only because it communicates one living, titlebar-adjacent object. - Popover is a single elevated material surface with a crisp border; result rows use tone changes, not individually elevated cards. - Header must remain draggable around the Island. Keep left/right noninteractive zones as `data-tauri-drag-region`; explicitly omit it on chip, input, and rows. - At `< 840px` desktop width, reduce chip metadata to title + count. At widths too narrow for a usable popover, allow the fixed overlay to span the safe viewport width; do not introduce a different mobile design in this slice. ### Initial selectors ```css .ocean-header { position: relative; } .island-host { position: absolute; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); } .island-chip { /* compact titlebar control */ } .island-scrim { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 120; } .island-popover { position: fixed; z-index: 121; top: var(--island-top); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); } .island-search__input { /* palette-like focus treatment */ } .island-result { /* one full-width interactive row */ } .island-result--selected { /* selected keyboard row */ } .island-result--focused { /* understated current-session marker */ } ``` Do not use `overflow: hidden` on `.ocean-header`; it would clip the popover. ## File-by-file change list | Path | Change | | --- | --- | | `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/lib.rs` or current module root | declare `mod island;` | | `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island.rs` | new pure derivation/search helpers + `Island` component + tests | | `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/app.rs` | Island state, header mount, `⌘P`, Escape priority, registry command | | `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/sessions.rs` | expose/shared metadata helpers only if needed; do not move panel UI | | `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/palette.rs` | move fuzzy scorer to a shared module or expose it safely; no duplicated score algorithm | | `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/search.rs` | recommended new shared fuzzy scorer if extraction is clean | | `styles/island.css` | new Island geometry and skin | | `index.html` | add stylesheet link | | extension build/style wiring | only if stylesheet packaging explicitly requires it | | `docs/OCEAN_DESKTOP_NORTH_STAR.md` | already records product direction; add implementation-doc link if docs use a links section | ## Tests ### Unit tests in `island.rs` - focused session sorts first - newer background sessions sort before older sessions - project derives from `owning_project` - project falls back to workspace-root match - origin prefix is stripped from title and exposed separately - title query beats project/path-only fuzzy query - empty query preserves derived order - `recent` / state text appears in searchable text if the chosen V1 behavior supports literal state queries - zero-turn session remains searchable ### Existing regression checks - `sessions.rs` grouping tests remain unchanged and pass - `palette.rs` fuzzy tests pass after helper extraction - verify `Daemon::switch_session` remains the only focus switch path ### Manual desktop acceptance run 1. Start Tauri app with ≥4 persisted sessions across ≥2 projects. 2. Verify chip is centered and does not overlap traffic lights, runtime controls, or workspace toggle. 3. Click chip: browse overlay opens, shows focused session first. 4. Click outside: closes. 5. Press `⌘P` from composer, workspace, and header: search opens and input has focus each time. 6. Type project, branch, title, cwd, and origin queries; confirm expected result. 7. Arrow down/up/Enter switches session and overlay closes. 8. Confirm old session is available when opening Island again. 9. Confirm `⌘K` palette still works and Escape closes exactly the topmost open surface. 10. Resize Tauri to narrow and wide widths; verify usable overlay geometry. 11. Verify browser PWA and extension preserve their existing Sessions-modal and browser-print behavior. ## Build sequence / commits Do not put all behavior in one giant commit. ### Commit 1 — Pure Island index - new `island.rs` types/derivation/search helpers - extract shared fuzzy score - unit tests only - no UI **Exit:** `cargo test` for the UI crate passes. ### Commit 2 — Island visual shell - component mounts on Tauri header - closed/browse state - display derived session rows - click row switches session - CSS and stylesheet wiring **Exit:** click-only interaction works; web has no visual change. ### Commit 3 — `⌘P` search mode - global shortcut - search input/focus - filtering, selection, keyboard navigation - Escape priority - registry discoverability command **Exit:** keyboard-only session focus switching works. ### Commit 4 — Live desktop polish - inspect an actual Tauri screenshot - tune titlebar spacing, type scale, row density, result limit, focus ring - run narrow/wide regressions **Exit:** the control feels built into the native shell rather than pasted over web chrome. ## Follow-up contract: required daemon work before richer Island states Do not fake background activity with only timestamps. For V2+ Island items, request an explicit daemon-owned stream/snapshot that can represent cross-session work truth: ```rust struct WorkAttentionItem { id: String, kind: Session | Permission | Browser | Ci | GitHub | Room | Council, session_id: Option, title: String, detail: Option, state: Idle | Running | NeedsHuman | Failed | Complete, updated_at: String, priority: u8, } ``` The daemon should own the source of truth. The Island is a reducer/view of that stream. This preserves the existing many-surfaces-one-daemon architecture and prevents a Tauri-only notion of work state. ## Explicit non-goal guardrails - Do not build inline quick reply until the daemon supports a safe background session prompt lifecycle or explicit foreground handoff semantics. - Do not add a local-only session index that diverges from daemon state. - Do not overload `⌘P` with generic mutating commands; that is `⌘K`. - Do not remove Sessions modal or add a rail until Island use is observed. - Do not impersonate macOS/iOS Dynamic Island visuals. Build an Ocean object using Ocean materials and behavior.

[package]
name = "ocean-surface-ui"
version = "0.1.0"
edition.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
authors.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true

# A Trunk CSR app is a plain binary crate: src/main.rs + fn main() that
# mounts the Leptos app. No [lib] needed.

[dependencies]
leptos        = { version = "0.8", features = ["csr"] }
serde         = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json    = "1"
wasm-bindgen  = "0.2"
wasm-bindgen-futures = "0.4"
gloo-net      = { version = "0.6", features = ["http", "eventsource"] }
gloo-timers   = { version = "0.3", features = ["futures"] }
futures-util  = "0.3"
console_error_panic_hook = "0.1"
console_log   = "1"
log           = "0.4"
pulldown-cmark = { version = "0.13", default-features = false, features = ["html"] }
web-sys = { version = "0.3", features = [
  "Window",
  "Location",
  "Document",
  "Element",
  "HtmlElement",
  "HtmlInputElement",
  "HtmlTextAreaElement",
  "HtmlFormElement",
  "Storage",
  "console",
  # Code component copy-to-clipboard
  "Clipboard",
  # Voice capture (push-to-talk → STT)
  "Navigator",
  "MediaDevices",
  "MediaStream",
  "MediaStreamConstraints",
  "MediaStreamTrack",
  "MediaRecorder",
  "MediaRecorderOptions",
  "BlobEvent",
  "Blob",
  "BlobPropertyBag",
  "Event",
  "Url",
  # TTS playback
  "HtmlAudioElement",
  # Continuous VAD listening (hands-free modes)
  "AudioContext",
  "BaseAudioContext",
  "AudioNode",
  "AnalyserNode",
  "MediaStreamAudioSourceNode",
  "PointerEvent",
  # CSPRNG for minting per-turn decision tokens (OCEAN-314).
  "Crypto",
  # Floating widget: depth-fade animation (get_bounding_client_rect, query_selector_all)
  "DomRect",
  "NodeList",
  # Reduced-motion check + path-node iteration for the wave-badge rAF loop
  "MediaQueryList",
  "Node",
  # OS presence (host.rs): native notify on Tauri (the notification plugin
  # polyfills window.Notification), standard Web Notifications on the PWA.
  "Notification",
  "NotificationOptions",
  "NotificationPermission",
  # Workspace browser pane (workspace_browser.rs): stream the agent daemon's
  # Chrome over SSE (EventSource + MessageEvent) and forward pointer/keyboard
  # input back over CDP (MouseEvent/WheelEvent/KeyboardEvent → POST).
  "EventSource",
  "MessageEvent",
  "EventTarget",
  "HtmlDivElement",
  "MouseEvent",
  "WheelEvent",
  "KeyboardEvent",
  # Realtime voice chat (voice phases 2/3): WebRTC peer connection to
  # OpenAI's Realtime API + data-channel tool calls (voice/realtime.rs).
  "RtcPeerConnection",
  "RtcSessionDescription",
  "RtcSessionDescriptionInit",
  "RtcSdpType",
  "RtcDataChannel",
  "RtcTrackEvent",
  "RtcRtpSender",
  "RtcIceGatheringState",
  # ── WebGL loader plate (loader.rs) ────────────────────────────────
  "HtmlCanvasElement",
  "CanvasRenderingContext2d",
  "CanvasGradient",
  "TextMetrics",
  "CssStyleDeclaration",
  "WebGlRenderingContext",
  "WebGlProgram",
  "WebGlShader",
  "WebGlBuffer",
  "WebGlTexture",
  "WebGlUniformLocation",
  "WebGlActiveInfo",
  "WebglLoseContext",
  "WebGlContextEvent",
] }
js-sys = "0.3"
# Satisfies on_cleanup's Send+Sync bound for the wave-badge rAF Rc state
# (sound on wasm's single thread).
send_wrapper = "0.6"

[features]
default = []

## Review

- **Correct:** The session picker uses a coherent combobox/listbox pattern: the search input owns `aria-controls`/`aria-activedescendant` (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island.rs:820-839`), and each non-Tabbable session option exposes `role="option"` plus reactive `aria-selected` (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island.rs:1003-1015`). Arrow/Enter handling is correctly scoped to the search input, so Enter on a disclosure cannot switch a session (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island.rs:644-695`). Disclosure summaries are native buttons with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island.rs:893-924`). The popdown remains one dialog/material surface, uses domain tokens rather than literal colors, avoids pulses, kills its transitions under reduced motion, and keeps row controls conditional.

- **Blocker:** The Tab trap is attached only to `.island-host` and therefore only handles key events whose focused target is still inside that subtree (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island.rs:586-640,754`). Activity is polled and keyed rows are removed when a request completes (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island.rs:491-493,856-967`). If the removed row or its `Open session` button held focus, focus falls outside the host; the next Tab never reaches this handler and can escape the `aria-modal` dialog. **Smallest fix:** install the Tab trap at `window`/`document` while the Island is open (and remove it on cleanup), or add an effect after attention updates that detects `activeElement` no longer contained by `popover_ref` and immediately focuses the search input. For a window-level trap, an outside current target must wrap to the first item (last for Shift+Tab), not default to index 0 and advance to item 2. Add a browser-level regression that removes the focused attention row and then presses Tab.
